flops.conventions: torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode; dense matmul/conv ops, sparse scatter propagation uncounted (identical accounting across arms); backward profiled through a scalar sum of logits
flops.formula: epochs*(train_epoch + val_pass) + val_pass + test_pass; lifting/loader preprocessing excluded, matching #14's per-run accounting

balanced_eval.note: balanced accuracy = mean per-class recall, argmax preds, best checkpoint reloaded; selection used plain val accuracy as wired (balanced never re-selects)
